info.description: The Aspen Syrup Detail Management API allows users to efficiently create and manage detailed records for Aspen syrup products within the catalog. This API facilitates the addition of essential information, such as product specifications and attributes, enhancing inventory management and customer engagement. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms who need to maintain an updated catalog. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure accurate and comprehensive product entries that support both online presence and supply chain operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create and submit detailed information regarding Aspen Syrup. It facilitates the entry of specific attributes related to the product and helps in maintaining accurate records.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details regarding aspen syrup operations. It expects a JSON object containing various attributes associated with the syrup details that are necessary for processing the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the details were retrieved.

aspen_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the aspen syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the aspen syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of aspen syrup requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the aspen syrup.
